phases.name: Project Bootstrap & Architecture Initialization
phases.summary: Repository inspected, requirements registry established, test harness & evidence structure initialized, baseline certified.

phases.name: Global Memory Governor & Allocation Budgets
phases.summary: Implementation of Bounded Memory Governor, allocation classes, pressure tiers, and eviction protocols.

phases.name: Storage Engine, Page Format, Page Cache & Async I/O
phases.summary: Fixed-size 4KB/8KB pages, CRC32C integrity checksums, Async I/O engine with priority queues and coalescing.

phases.name: Write-Ahead Log, Durability & Recovery Safety
phases.summary: Append-only WAL manager, fsync durability, crash recovery replay, and generation verification.

phases.name: Security Guard, Hardened Parsing & Hardware Telemetry
phases.summary: Path traversal defense, integer overflow guard, unadulterated telemetry reporting UNSUPPORTED when metrics unavailable.

phases.name: Query Engine, Chunks, Vector Batches & CPU/GPU Fallback
phases.summary: Vectorized execution pipelines, chunk streaming, CPU fallback on device loss or memory pressure.
